column1: # (1500x code line + random nonce => ~18k tokens, cold prefill, max_tokens=300, temp 0.7).
# CAVEAT: n=2-4 per arm, NOT interleaved. cloud1's protocol is n>=10 across two
# interleaved blocks. Adequate for the large effects (DPM, wrapper); NOT adequate to
# resolve 2-3% differences. Do not cite the 319-vs-458 delta as real.
# Rows marked probe=1 had concurrent sysfs polling (sclk/power/temp) during the run.
# Baseline for comparison, from p14s-toolbox-sys.tsv (n=12): PP 485-493, TG 21.5
#   as-found          raw binary, DPM auto, original flags (-ngl 99 -c 262144 -ctk/-ctv q8_0 -kvu --spec-type draft-mtp)
#   flags-only        + all P14S-NATIVE-INSTALL.md sec9c server flags, DPM still auto
#   no-mmproj         AC + DPM high, --mmproj removed (vision disabled; capabilities showed ['completion'])
#   wrapper-b458      AC + DPM high, launched via vulkan/llama-server wrapper (bundled Mesa 26.3.0 + 7 GGML_VK vars)
#   wrapper-b319      same, but toolbox v0.2 build 319 (54d76da) from /opt/llama/strix-toolbox-v0.2
#   sysmesa-envon     ISOLATION ARM: system Mesa 26.0.3, but 7 GGML_VK vars set explicitly.
#                     Separates "env vars" from "driver swap" in the wrapper's ~8% gain.
#   kisak-mesa-26.1.6 Mesa 26.1.6 from the kisak-mesa PPA, extracted from the .deb into a
#                     private dir and selected via VK_ICD_FILENAMES. NOT installed system-wide.
# Mesa driver ranking (all: build 458, DPM high, AC, 7 GGML_VK vars set):
#   kisak  26.1.6   433-446 PP  (mean 442)   <- best; vindicates the doc's 26.1.5 pin
# The GGML_VK env vars themselves are worth ~0% on build 458 (392-409 -> 400-407, noise):
# the binaries already default them on since fork commit 0b29b30. The wrapper's ~8% gain
# was almost entirely the DRIVER SWAP, not the vars.
# GPU telemetry sampled under sustained load:
#   DPM auto : sclk ~1150 MHz, 100% busy, 13 W
#   DPM high : sclk  2900 MHz,  ~99% busy, 49-58 W, 68-89 C
# DIFFERENT SILICON: Radeon 8060S (gfx1151, 40 CU) vs p14's 890M (gfx1150, 16 CU).
# Method also differs: llama-bench pp2048 @ fixed KV depth, not a full-prefill average.
# Absolute values do NOT transfer; included for backend ranking and scale check only.
# llama-bench, 35B-A3B Q8, fa1, d32768 -- RADV vs AMDVLK prefill:
#   (AMDVLK is 2.2x SLOWER for prefill; the repo README's "fastest backend" claim
#    does not hold for MoE prompt processing.)
